about: DiscGolfRecs starter catalog (2026-10-22): discs only (distance drivers, fairway drivers, midranges and putters), one entry per mold — the plastic varies and is not part of the name. A mold is in the catalog when the maker lists it now: Innova's disc charts, the shared MVP/Axiom/Streamline disc list (molds pictured as out of production left out), discraft.com's category pages and the Discraft factory store (factory seconds and misprints count as current runs), and the maker's own store for Latitude 64, Dynamic Discs, Westside, Kastaplast, Discmania, Prodigy and Thought Space Athletics. Prototypes, club exclusives, minis and sets are left out. Type is the maker's own category where it gives one (hybrid drivers counted as fairway drivers, approach discs as putters), otherwise Marshall Street's flight guide. Flight numbers (speed / glide / turn / fade) are the maker's own for Innova, MVP, Axiom, Streamline and Discmania, otherwise Marshall Street's flight guide; rim width and max weight are the PDGA-approved figures printed in that guide. Plastics are the base plastics the maker lists (Innova, MVP family) or sells the mold in on its store (effects such as Orbit, Burst, Swirl or Glow runs left off); blank when not read. Columns: shape = type, weight = flight numbers, balance = rim width, core = plastics, surface = max weight.
